# Naksh Studio

> Naksh Studio is a premium clothing brand based in Karachi, Pakistan, designing
> heavy-weight, oversized-fit t-shirts and trousers. Orders are placed on the
> website and confirmed directly with the customer via WhatsApp; delivery and
> exchanges are currently limited to Karachi.

## Key facts
- Location: Karachi, Sindh, Pakistan
- Products: premium t-shirts and trousers (men's essentials)
- Ordering: browse online, then confirm the order via WhatsApp (+92 318 1058796)
- Delivery area: Karachi only
- Returns: no cash refunds; approved exchanges receive Online Store Credit,
  valid 14 days, for items in unworn/unwashed condition within 14 days of delivery
- Currency: Pakistani Rupees (PKR)

## Pages

- All products: https://www.nakshshop.com/products
